SRCDS_APPID.desc: SteamCMD application id of the Starbound dedicated server

STEAM_AUTH.desc: Steam Guard code or login token. Leave empty when the account has no Steam Guard.

STEAM_USER.desc: Steam account that owns Starbound. The server files are not available to anonymous Steam users.

UPDATE_ON_BOOT.desc: Run SteamCMD before every server start so the server is always up to date

WORKSHOP.desc: Link every .pak already downloaded under steamapps/workshop into the mods folder on boot

port.desc: TCP port the game server binds to

install.text:
{
  "allowAdminCommands" : true,
  "allowAdminCommandsFromAnyone" : false,
  "allowAnonymousConnections" : true,
  "allowAssetsMismatch" : true,
  "anonymousConnectionsAreAdmin" : false,
  "bannedIPs" : [],
  "bannedUuids" : [],
  "checkAssetsDigest" : false,
  "clearPlayerFiles" : false,
  "clearUniverseFiles" : false,
  "clientIPJoinable" : false,
  "clientP2PJoinable" : true,
  "configurationVersion" : {
    "basic" : 2,
    "server" : 4
  },
  "crafting" : {
    "filterHaveMaterials" : false
  },
  "gameServerBind" : "::",
  "gameServerPort" : ${port},
  "interactiveHighlight" : true,
  "inventory" : {
    "pickupToActionBar" : true
  },
  "maxPlayers" : 8,
  "maxTeamSize" : 4,
  "monochromeLighting" : false,
  "playerBackupFileCount" : 3,
  "queryServerBind" : "::",
  "queryServerPort" : 21025,
  "rconServerBind" : "::",
  "rconServerPassword" : "",
  "rconServerPort" : 21026,
  "rconServerTimeout" : 1000,
  "runQueryServer" : false,
  "runRconServer" : false,
  "safeScripts" : true,
  "scriptInstructionLimit" : 10000000,
  "scriptInstructionMeasureInterval" : 10000,
  "scriptProfilingEnabled" : false,
  "scriptRecursionLimit" : 100,
  "serverFidelity" : "automatic",
  "serverName" : "A Starbound Server",
  "serverOverrideAssetsDigest" : null,
  "serverUsers" : {
  },
  "tutorialMessages" : true
}

commands: bash -c 'mkdir -p mods; for dir in steamapps/workshop/content/211820/*/; do [ -d "$dir" ] || continue; id=$(basename "$dir"); n=0; for pak in "$dir"*.pak; do [ -f "$pak" ] || continue; ln -rsf "$pak" "mods/$id.$n.pak"; n=$((n+1)); done; done'

bash -c 'mkdir -p mods; for dir in steamapps/workshop/content/211820/*/; do [ -d "$dir" ] || continue; id=$(basename "$dir"); n=0; for pak in "$dir"*.pak; do [ -f "$pak" ] || continue; ln -rsf "$pak" "mods/$id.$n.pak"; n=$((n+1)); done; done'
